name: Lake Wedowee Winery and Brewery
description: Lake Wedowee Winery is Wedowee Alabama's premier winery and tasting room. Located in beautiful downtown Wedowee less than a mile from the Lake Wedowee shoreline. Welcome to Lake Wedowee Winery and Brewery! Wedowee Alabama's Premier Winery, Tasting, and Tap Room Conveniently located near Cheaha State Park, Talladega Superspeedway, Atlanta, GA, Birmingham, AL, and Auburn, AL.
